layer_name: Layer 1: Background Intensity, Micro-Texture & Structural Consistency

held_out_test_set.methodology_note: Performance on the current held-out evaluation dataset (synthetic template-based). Real-world physical scans with diverse camera sensors, lighting, and wear will exhibit natural genuine variance and lower separation margins.

controlled_experiment.description: Synthetic localized photo-splice with 100% untouched background
controlled_experiment.interpretation: Layer 1 passed the untouched background, correctly functioning as a background-consistency detector. Upstream portrait alterations are designated to Layer 2 (Photo Boundary) and Layer 4 (ELA).
